verdict.rationale: Conductor's pricing page says 'Bring your own subscriptions and keys' [conductor-docs-19]. The changelog lets you choose per organization whether Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor use an API key or a subscription [conductor-docs-23], and adds signing in to a Cursor subscription for cloud workspaces [conductor-docs-7]. The developer also notes locally it runs on your own Claude Code installation [conductor-comm-15], and the app walks you through missing credentials on launch [conductor-docs-33]. Missing for 10: in-depth docs of the subscription sign-in flow and which plans or agents qualify (e.g., OpenCode), plus independent hands-on confirmation that subscription sign-in works.
